# zkVM protocol vectors

Verbatim copies from [davinci-zkvm](https://github.com/vocdoni/davinci-zkvm) at
commit `adb268f604cceea84f0c0ce621d5cd5f31bd89ef`, whose `rust-sdk/` is identical
to tag v0.1.0 (the files below last changed in `78d07ad`). The Rust SDK tests
against the same files, and its code is what `src/crypto` and `src/protocol`
mirror. Do not edit or reformat them: the tests compare byte for byte, and the
checksums below identify the copy.

| File | Source | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `poseidon.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (go-iden3-crypto) | `test/crypto/unit/Poseidon.test.ts` |
| `babyjubjub.json`, `elgamal.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` | `BabyJubJub.test.ts`, `Ballot.test.ts` |
| `ballot_mode.json`, `ballots.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` | `Ballot.test.ts` |
| `real_proof.json`, `real_proof_v1.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (rapidsnark proofs under the current and the v1.0.0 key) | `Ballot.test.ts`, `VkHash.test.ts` |
| `hashes.json`, `genesis.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` | `VkHash.test.ts` |
| `ballot_proof_vkey.json` | `rust-sdk/assets/` (davinci-circom `artifacts/ballot_proof_vkey.json` at a39a9f9) | `VkHash.test.ts` |
| `leanimt.json`, `census.json`, `slot.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (lean-imt-go, Go reference) | `Census.test.ts`, `Ecdsa.test.ts` |
| `voteid_sig.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (go-ethereum) | `Ecdsa.test.ts` |
| `dkg_schnorr.json` | `rust-sdk/testdata/` (davinci-dkg) | `Dkg.test.ts` |
| `limits.rs`, `release.rs` | `rust-sdk/src/` | `test/protocol/unit/Protocol.test.ts` |

The JSON vectors are generated by `go-sdk/cmd/sdk-vectors` in davinci-zkvm. Some
integers in them (vote ids, slots) exceed 2^53; `test/helpers/fixtures.ts` reads
those as strings.

`dkg_schnorr.json`'s `description` still names a Poseidon transcript. The organizer
values in it were produced with the keccak transcript that `rust-sdk/src/dkg.rs` and
davinci-dkg's `DKGAppManager` use, which is the one the SDK implements.

To refresh: copy the files from a newer davinci-zkvm, update the commit and the
checksums here, and re-run `yarn test:unit`.
